property_summary: Filling any long order must store the position expiration under the long position id and leave the returned short-side positionId's expiration untouched (zero); the mutant always writes it under positionId, so positionExpirations(positionId) becomes nonzero after a long fill.
change_summary: Always store the expiration under positionId instead of conditionally choosing uint256(orderHash) for long orders.
